svg.title: mwm2: tile
svg.desc: Holding Left Option, the cursor drags a window to the right screen edge and it tiles to the right half, then to the top-left corner for a quarter, the bottom-right corner for another, and the top edge for the whole screen. An outline previews each tile before the drop.

g.text: Drop on a side for half the screen.
Near a corner for a quarter.
On the top edge for all of it.
